method: Live console, read-only. Actions menu opened against an in-use volume and every item's aria-disabled recorded. Nothing was invoked.
capture_limitation: Every volume in the sampled account was In-use, so only half the matrix is observed. What the console does with an `available` volume is inferred from which items it disables while in-use, and is marked as such below rather than presented as captured.

Resilience testing.note: labelled 'Resilience testing' with the subtitle 'Previously fault injection'
Resilience testing.constraint_text: Test up to 5 volumes in the same AZ.

enabled_only_when_available.basis: sourced — both were disabled against an in-use volume

enabled_only_when_in_use.basis: inferred — enabled here, but no available volume existed to confirm they are disabled in that state

task_design_implication: Detaching then deleting a volume is a two-state sequence: Delete is refused while the volume is attached, so a task that ends in deletion must pass through detach and wait for the volume to reach available.
